title: GCP partner ambassador 1:1 prep - jamie
content:
Quick scratchpad for 1:1 with the GCP partner ambassador (Tue 11/05) — informal, bring notes, confirm asks.

Context / why this matters
- We want GCP marketplace pilot to accelerate inbound enterprise trials with zero-touch provisioning. Ambassador is our single point for marketplace onboarding + co-sell guidance.
- Current blockers: listing CSS imagery not approved, API credentials flow unclear for private deployments, pricing SKU mapping mismatch with our usage bands.
- Goal for this org: get pilot approved for Private + Dedicated customers and a co-marketing slot for Q1.

Primary objectives for the 1:1
1) Clarify onboarding timeline for Marketplace listing review (compliance checklist and expected gate dates).
2) Confirm technical path for VPC/on-prem customers to appear in the Marketplace (billing + KMS implications).
3) Ask for a small pilot program favor (visibility + 1 co-sell intro to two field reps).
4) Capture ambassador requests and document next steps + owners.

Attendees (tentative)
- GCP ambassador: David Liu (counterparty)
- Me: Jamie Park (channel lead)
- Optional: Miguel (technical partner engineer), Priya (legal review) — ask David if he wants a quick technical sync after.

Key talking points (short bullets to run through)
- Quick 30s refresh of Redwood Inference business and traction (hosted API, Dedicated, Private). Emphasize production SLA needs.
- Pilot ask: list us as private deployment-friendly + allow a non-public product tile for enterprise trials (need GCP guidance on acceptable wording).
- Technical: confirm support for BYOK (KMS/HSM) flow in listing and any required attestation docs. Who signs the attestation?
- Pricing: we need an SKU mapping suggestion — we usually have per-token and embedding units; how to map to GCP marketplace SKU semantics?
- Billing: want guidance on metered billing / reconciliations for Private deployments (we may invoice directly for Dedicated/Private).
- Co-marketing: request 1 PR/announcement in Jan + intro to two field BD reps for Seattle and London.

Open questions to ask David (write these out and mark answers live)
- Does GCP allow marketplace tile for solutions that require a signed contract before provisioning? (yes/no + recommended wording)
- What artifacts are mandatory for BYOK/KMS in listing review? Example forms?
- Expected review SLA for textual content vs technical security review (days).
- Can we include a link to a hosted demo with restricted access? (how to present credentials to reviewers)
- Are there recommended monitoring hooks/labels GCP wants on images for telemetry to support co-sell?

Risk list (notes to self)
- Legal: hybrid billing may require unusual terms — loop in Priya early.
- Tech: SRE needs to ensure our onboarding flow doesn't leak customer metadata during verification.
- Marketing: if co-marketing not available, pilot velocity could slow. Flag potential fallback: social case study + self-serve demo.

Technical checklist to confirm with ambassador / partner engineer
- OAuth/client flow for provisioning marketplace trial (who owns the OAuth client?)
- Does GCP require a marketplace-managed identity for private listings?
- BYOK: required KMS key format + whether HSM attestation needed
- Firewalls / VPC peering guidance for pilot customers
- Test accounts: request 1 sandbox tenant + admin credentials for validation (expires)

Desired asks / asks phrased succinctly
- "Can GCP expedite our security attestation review once we supply docs?"
- "Would you introduce us to Seattle + London field reps for two target accounts?"
- "Can we get a private tile option or a Marketplace preview listing for pilot customers?"

Proposed next steps (post-call) — write down owner + due date during 1:1
- Share marketplace draft content (listing description + screenshots) with David for pre-review — owner: Jamie — due: 2024-11-11
- Miguel to produce minimal BYOK doc + architecture diagram — owner: Miguel Santos — due: 2024-11-14
- Priya to flag any legal terms likely to block (esp. billing) and draft a redline playbook — owner: Priya Nair — due: 2024-11-18
- Follow-up technical walkthrough with GCP PE if David requests — owner: Miguel — target: week of 11/18
- Create a short co-marketing brief (one-pager) for David to share with field — owner: Jamie — due: 2024-11-15

Notes-to-self for the meeting
- Bring concrete listing blurb (one paragraph), at least 2 screenshot variants (hosted vs private), rough pricing bands, and the BYOK diagram.
- Keep ask tight: 1 pilot listing + 2 field intros. If they push on resources, offer a 2-week technical SPOC from Redwood.
- Listen for signals: if they ask about compliance certifications (ISO/SOC), be ready with our cert list and how Dedicated maps to compliance controls.

Follow-up template to send after the call (copy/paste friendly)
Hi David,

Thanks for the time today — appreciate the guidance. Per our conversation, attaching the marketplace blurb, BYOK diagram, and a one-pager on co-marketing. Next steps we captured: 1) Redwood to share listing draft by 11/11 (Jamie), 2) Miguel to send BYOK doc 11/14, 3) Priya to review legal terms by 11/18. Please let me know if you'd like a technical walkthrough or an intro to our SRE lead for the private-deploy details.

Thanks — Jamie

TODO (personal)
- [ ] Add exact product screenshots to the doc before sending
- [ ] Convert BYOK diagram to PNG and upload to shared drive link
- [ ] Draft short co-marketing ask email for field reps (one paragraph)
- [ ] Prep backup ask: case study + joint webinar if co-sell intro is delayed

Random thoughts / brainstorm (low priority)
- Could propose a limited-time zero-commission pilot for referrals to speed field adoption — might need finance sign-off.
- If GCP wants a private tile, could we use a "redwood-inference (private)" naming convention to reduce confusion in their catalog.

End of notes. Will tidy and move to shared_drives/channel once David confirms time and we capture answers.
